text: Mobil 1 is a lubricants brand of Exxon Mobil Corporation.

source.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Specialty Products (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Specialty Products is well-positioned to help meet the demand for premium lubricant products through advantaged projects that leverage ExxonMobil's integration, technology, and world-class brands, such as Mobil 1

additionalSources.name: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls: New Partnership With ExxonMobil
additionalSources.quote: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls has today announced its new partnership with ExxonMobil as it becomes the Fuels and Lubricants Partner to VCARB in a new sponsorship with the Mobil, Esso and Mobil 1 brands.
